extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the Web Store.

extDescription.message: Business calculators for ROI, liquidity, break-even, NPV, IRR and more. Everything is computed on your device.
extDescription.description: Extension description. Keep it at 132 characters or fewer (Web Store limit).

commandOpen.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut that opens the popup.

calculatorLabel.description: Label of the drop-down that selects a calculator.

inputsLabel.description: Accessible name of the section with the input fields.

resultsLabel.description: Accessible name of the section with the results.

exampleButton.description: Button that fills the form with sample values.

settingsButtonTitle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the settings button.

resultsEmpty.message: Fill in the fields to see the results.
resultsEmpty.description: Shown in place of the results while the form is incomplete or invalid.

resultUndefined.description: Shown instead of a result that cannot be computed for the given inputs.

resultUndefinedHint.message: This result is not defined for these values, for example because of a division by zero or because no solution exists.
resultUndefinedHint.description: Tooltip of a result that is not defined.

formulaLabel.description: Heading of the formula note under the results.

copyResults.description: Button that copies the inputs and results as text.

statusCopyFailed.message: Could not copy to the clipboard.
statusCopyFailed.description: Status when the clipboard write fails.

footer.message: Computed on your device; nothing you type is sent anywhere. Estimates, not financial advice.

seriesHint.message: One value per line (or separated by semicolons). Use a minus sign for outflows.
seriesHint.description: Hint under a list field such as cash flows.

settingsBack.description: Button that leaves the settings view.

currencyNone.description: Currency option that shows plain numbers.

decimalsLabel.message: Decimal places for percentages and ratios

rememberInputsLabel.message: Remember what I typed while the browser is open

rememberInputsHint.message: Kept in browser memory only and erased when Chrome closes. Turning this off deletes it now.

errorNotNumber.description: Field error: the text is not a number.

errorNotInteger.description: Field error: a whole number is required.

errorMinExclusive.description: Field error: not above the exclusive minimum.

errorNotAllowed.message: Choose a value from the list.
errorNotAllowed.description: Field error: not one of the allowed choices.

errorInvalidEntry.message: Entry $POSITION$ is not a valid number.
errorInvalidEntry.description: Field error: an entry of a list is not a number.

group_returns.description: Heading of a group of calculators.

group_profitability.description: Heading of a group of calculators.

group_liquidity.description: Heading of a group of calculators.

group_investment.description: Heading of a group of calculators.

calc_roi_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_roi_desc.message: How much an investment gained or lost compared with what was put in.
calc_roi_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_roi_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_cagr_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_cagr_desc.message: The steady yearly growth rate that takes a value from its start to its end.
calc_cagr_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_cagr_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_roe_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_roe_desc.message: How much profit a company makes from its shareholders' equity and from its assets.
calc_roe_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_roe_formula.message: ROE = Net income ÷ Equity · ROA = Net income ÷ Assets
calc_roe_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_margin_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_margin_desc.message: Profit as a share of the selling price (margin) and of the cost (markup).
calc_margin_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_margin_formula.message: Margin = (Price − Cost) ÷ Price · Markup = (Price − Cost) ÷ Cost
calc_margin_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_pricing_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_pricing_desc.message: The selling price that gives the margin you want, and the markup it takes.
calc_pricing_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_pricing_formula.message: Price = Cost ÷ (1 − Margin) · Markup = Margin ÷ (1 − Margin)
calc_pricing_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_breakeven_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_breakeven_desc.message: How many units you must sell to cover your fixed costs, and optionally reach a profit goal.
calc_breakeven_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_breakeven_formula.message: Units = (Fixed costs + Target profit) ÷ (Price − Variable cost)
calc_breakeven_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_liquidity_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_liquidity_desc.message: Whether a company can pay its short-term obligations with its short-term assets.
calc_liquidity_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_liquidity_formula.message: Current = Current assets ÷ Current liabilities · Quick = (Cash + Receivables) ÷ Current liabilities · Cash = Cash ÷ Current liabilities
calc_liquidity_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_cashCycle_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_cashCycle_desc.message: How many days cash stays tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
calc_cashCycle_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_cashCycle_formula.message: CCC = Inventory days + Receivable days − Payable days
calc_cashCycle_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_leverage_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_leverage_desc.message: How much a company relies on debt, and how comfortably its earnings cover the interest.
calc_leverage_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_leverage_formula.message: Debt/Equity = Debt ÷ Equity · Debt/Capital = Debt ÷ (Debt + Equity) · Coverage = EBIT ÷ Interest
calc_leverage_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_investment_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_investment_desc.message: Is a project worth it? Discounts its future cash flows and finds when it pays for itself.
calc_investment_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_investment_formula.message: NPV = Σ CFₜ ÷ (1 + r)ᵗ − Investment · IRR: the rate where NPV = 0
calc_investment_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_futureValue_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_futureValue_desc.message: How much a sum, plus regular deposits, grows to with compound interest.
calc_futureValue_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_futureValue_formula.message: FV = PV × (1 + i)ⁿ + Deposit × ((1 + i)ⁿ − 1) ÷ i, with i = annual rate ÷ periods per year
calc_futureValue_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_loan_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_loan_desc.message: The fixed monthly payment of a loan and how much interest it costs in total.
calc_loan_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_loan_formula.message: Payment = Principal × i ÷ (1 − (1 + i)⁻ⁿ), with i = annual rate ÷ 12
calc_loan_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

marketOff.message: Selic and dollar rates can be filled in from the Central Bank of Brazil.
marketOff.description: Shown under the fields of a market calculator while live rates are off.

marketEnable.description: Button that turns on live rates and downloads them.

marketUse.description: Button that puts the downloaded Selic and dollar rates into the fields.

marketRetry.description: Button that tries to download the rates again.

marketLoading.description: Shown while the rates are being downloaded.

marketFailed.message: Could not reach the Central Bank. Check your connection.
marketFailed.description: Shown when the download of the rates fails.

marketRates.description: The downloaded rates and the date of the dollar quote.

statusMarketPermissionDenied.message: Permission denied, so no rates were fetched.
statusMarketPermissionDenied.description: Status when the user declines the permission to contact the Central Bank.

liveRatesLabel.message: Fetch the Selic rate and the dollar quote from the Central Bank of Brazil

liveRatesHint.message: Off by default. When on, Chrome asks permission to contact api.bcb.gov.br, which receives no information about you. Turning this off removes the permission.

group_markets.description: Heading of a group of calculators.

calc_selicYield_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_selicYield_desc.message: What an investment that pays a share of the Selic returns after income tax.
calc_selicYield_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_selicYield_formula.message: Net profit = Amount × (growth − 1) × (1 − income tax); growth accrues daily over 252 business days a year
calc_selicYield_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

calc_savings_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_savings_desc.message: Compares the savings account with a taxed fixed-income product, and finds the share of the Selic at which they tie.
calc_savings_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_savings_formula.message: Savings: 0.5% a month if the Selic is above 8.5%, else 70% of the Selic. Fixed income pays regressive income tax
calc_savings_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

field_savings_percentOfRate.message: Percentage of the Selic paid (fixed income)

out_savings_breakEvenPercent.message: Share of the Selic to tie

calc_dollarConversion_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_dollarConversion_desc.message: How many dollars your reais buy once the bank's spread and the IOF tax are counted.
calc_dollarConversion_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_dollarConversion_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.

out_dollarConversion_costPercent.message: Cost as a share of the amount

calc_dollarVsSelic_name.description: Name of the calculator in the list.

calc_dollarVsSelic_desc.message: Where must the dollar be at the end for holding dollars to beat the Selic? Compared gross, before income tax.
calc_dollarVsSelic_desc.description: One-sentence explanation shown under the calculator selector.

calc_dollarVsSelic_formula.message: Break-even dollar = Selic result ÷ dollars held at the end
calc_dollarVsSelic_formula.description: Plain-text formula shown under the results. Keep the operators.
